fact: UNDP says the Ministry of Health, with UNDP and Global Fund support, installed two portable AI-assisted digital X-ray machines for TB case detection at Torit and Rumbek state hospitals in December 2023, with four more to follow.

WHO's South Sudan knowledge series (September 2026) reports the Digital Care Companion, a clinical decision support system on symbolic AI, logging 3,168 patient visits across 12 facilities in 10 States and Administrative Areas, with clinicians accepting its diagnosis recommendations.
WHO reports 64.9% of the Digital Care Companion's diagnosis recommendations were accepted by clinicians and 95.0% of 3,168 logged consultations were completed through all nine steps.
